text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin and Biwa Hayahide ended up 
letting victory slip through their fingers 
in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Distraught over losing due to poor 
conditioning, and utterly exhausted in 
body and mind, Narita Taishin vents her 
weakness—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She asked to take a short break from both 
racing and training.
